name: Grow frameset

editorial.verdict: A strong aero-gravel candidate with a light raw frame and 50 mm rear clearance, but its geometry is gravel-race rather than a road-race chassis.
strengths: A public SRAM custom build was reported at 6.53 kg
caveats: Manufacturing provenance less transparent than Winspace
The 830 g headline is the lightest size; larger sizes rise to 960 g and the fork is a separate 460 g claim
The 6.53 kg figure is build-specific, not a stock or factory-weight claim
The official page does not establish the exact 2× compatibility or justify a 1×-only label

purchase_route: Current Tavelo manufacturer store lists the exact Grow frameset at US$1,650 and provides a retailer finder. Confirm selected size, paint, package, mainland delivery, tax and lifetime-warranty eligibility before payment.
